expectations.text: Gives the researcher partner and the contract-worried partner distinct messaging angles, neither of which could run unchanged against the other role
expectations.evidence: Section 1 splits creative explicitly: "comparison/efficiency numbers for the researcher, 'fixed-price, no-pressure, cancel-anytime consult' language for the contract-wary one." Retargeting is likewise split ("financing calculator to one, no-obligation-quote reassurance to the other"), and section 2 carries it into the in-home moment ("hand off the 'researcher' a spec sheet and the 'risk-averse' spouse a plain-language, fixed-price quote"), plus a language-mining split (efficiency ratings/financing terms vs. "locked in," "pressured," "fine print"). The angles are genuinely non-interchangeable —
